title: Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai Remix
native_title: アイドル雀士スーチーパイ・リミックス
overview:
Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai Remix is an adult strip mahjong game. Choose one of seven female mahjong players and take on the rest of the field in one-on-one mahjong against the computer, then face the boss. Every player has her own signature cheating technique, and you can use cheats of your own to turn a hand around.

Win a hand and the value of your winning hand earns turns at a memory-style panel match, where pairing up matching pictures earns new cheat techniques and points. Turn over every panel to clear a stage.

This Remix edition keeps the game of Suchie-Pai Special with reworked illustrations and an all-new soundtrack. Rated for players 18 and over.
